Lina (AE): Quick sync — Horizon POC ends tomorrow. They want hosted keys revoked, the dedicated pool torn down, and signed confirmation of data purge. Can we own tasks?

Omar (SE): I can revoke hosted keys at 08:00 UTC. Will run smoke tests to prove 401s.

Dev (Infra): I'll handle pool drain+delete. Plan: drain 08:10, snapshot optional at 08:20 if requested, delete at 09:00. Will export logs to s3://redwood-exports/horizon/.

June (Security): Keep audit CSV. We need proof of telemetry purge if they opted out of storage. Also rotate admin token after.

Mark (Customer Ops): Horizon requires the list of keys and service accounts beforehand. We also need the export link and retention duration.

Lina (AE): Owners: Omar keys; Dev pool+logs; June compliance sign-off; Mark customer confirmation. Window 08:00-09:30 UTC. I'll notify Horizon.

Omar (SE): Revoke command I'll run: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/revoke -d '{"key_id":"horizon-poc-01"}' with admin token. Will paste 401 check results here.

Dev (Infra): Noted. I'll post deletion ack JSON with timestamp after complete.

June (Security): I'll create evidence JIRA and upload CSV there.

Lina (AE): Great. Post final ack in this thread and I'll close the POC.
